description: Findings 2 and 5. (2) GET /api/notifications/debug and POST /api/test-notification stay registered but answer 404 (as if absent) unless DEMO_MODE or NODE_ENV !== 'production'. No test or rendered UI uses them (public/recipients.html has a dead testNotification() caller with no button in the markup; do not touch public/). (5) Mount archiveRoutes BEFORE the global error handler in server.js without changing the ordered route list. Independent of FEAT-001/003 but run after FEAT-001 (shared files server.js and routes/notifications.js, different regions). Line numbers at base 91e02a6 and may have shifted slightly after FEAT-001.
steps: Re-grep tests/ and public/ for `test-notification|notifications/debug` to reconfirm: only public/recipients.html testNotification() references the POST and nothing in tests/ does.

routes/notifications.js: above the debug route (L99-100) add, with a one-line comment (`// Debug/test endpoints: answer only in demo mode or outside production; otherwise 404 as if they did not exist`), `function debugOnly(req, res, next) { if (DEMO_MODE || process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return next(); return next('route'); }`. Register it BEFORE requireAuth on both routes: `router.get('/api/notifications/debug', debugOnly, requireAuth, async ...)` (L100) and `router.post('/api/test-notification', debugOnly, requireAuth, async ...)` (L316). Do not move or reorder the routes, and do not change their bodies (FEAT-001 may have edited other parts of the file).

server.js: delete the two lines `// Registered after the error handler, exactly as before the split` / `app.use(archiveRoutes);` (L167-168) and add `app.use(archiveRoutes);` immediately after `app.use(recipientRoutes.lateRouter); // POST /api/user/identify` (L146), BEFORE the `// Error handling middleware` block. Add a short comment that it is mounted before the error handler so its errors get the JSON response. Change nothing else in the mount order.

Fake-DB harness (plan 'Verification toolkit'): boot 3 modes and record status for GET /api/notifications/debug and POST /api/test-notification both authenticated and unauthenticated: (a) OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=production (X-Forwarded-Proto: https) expect authed 200 (unauthed 401); (b) fake DB, DB_PASSWORD=x NODE_ENV=development expect authed not 404 (200) and unauthed 401; (c) fake DB, NODE_ENV=production expect 404 for all four and a body identical to GET /api/this-does-not-exist.

Route list: regenerate with the temp route-walk script and diff against the baseline produced at the start of FEAT-001 (and the parent workspace's server-split-routes-before.txt): must be identical (66 routes, same order). Confirm the 4-arity error layer is now the last entry in app._router.stack.

Archive error proof: temp harness that requires ./routes/archive first, appends router.get('/api/archive/__boom', () => { throw new Error('boom'); }), then boots demo mode, logs in and GETs it. After the fix the response is the global handler's JSON error (not Express's default HTML). Optionally `git stash`-free proof of the old behavior: run the same harness against `git show HEAD:server.js` copy only if cheap; otherwise state that the pre-fix behavior is by construction (default finalhandler). Delete the harness.
node --check server.js routes/notifications.js. Delete every tmp-*.js.

Commit: `git add server.js routes/notifications.js` by name only, message e.g. `fix(security): 404 debug endpoints in production`, body mentions both the gating and the archive mount order, no sim trailer, do not push. Set status completed and record findings (status-code table, route-list result).
acceptance_criteria: Both routes are still registered (present in the ordered route list at the same positions) and are protected by debugOnly before requireAuth
demo+production: 200 authed; non-demo+development: 200 authed; non-demo+production: 404 for authed AND unauthenticated requests, indistinguishable from an unknown path
Ordered route list is byte-identical to the baseline (66 routes); archive routes are still the last three
app.use(archiveRoutes) now precedes the error handler and an error thrown inside an archive route returns the JSON error response
Nothing in public/ or tests/ changed
verification: Status-code matrix from the fake-DB harness matches the acceptance criteria
Route list diff vs baseline is empty
findings: Committed as 5b179cb on fix/harden-server-1 (server.js, routes/notifications.js; 10+/5-; not pushed). Grep reconfirmed: only public/recipients.html:2214 references test-notification, nothing in tests/. CRLF preserved (bareLF=0), node --check OK. STATUS MATRIX (fake-DB/demo harness, login via POST /api/login with X-Forwarded-Proto: https; authed = GET/POST debug|test): (a) OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=production: debug authed 200 / unauth 401, test authed 200 / unauth 401. (b) fake DB DB_PASSWORD=x NODE_ENV=development: debug authed 200 (userSubscriptions etc.) / unauth 401, test authed 200 / unauth 401. (c) fake DB NODE_ENV=production: all four 404 (authed and unauth), no [DEBUG]/[TEST] log lines emitted. The 404 bodies are Express's default HTML 'Cannot GET /api/notifications/debug' / 'Cannot POST /api/test-notification', identical in form to the unknown-path 404 ('Cannot GET /api/this-does-not-exist'); they differ only in the echoed path (a raw byte compare of bodies is therefore false by design). ROUTE LIST: regenerated with temp walker, 66 routes, fc /b vs %TEMP%\harden-routes-before.txt = no differences, line-wise identical to the parent server-split-routes-before.txt; last three are POST /api/archive/run, GET /api/archive/years, GET /api/archive/presents; the 4-arity error layer is now the LAST entry of app._router.stack (index 23 of 24). ARCHIVE PROOF: temp harness adding router.get('/api/archive/__boom', throw) to routes/archive: after fix -> 500 application/json {"error":"Błąd serwera"} (global handler); same harness against a copy of HEAD~ server.js (archive mounted after the error handler) -> 500 text/html Express default error page. Nothing in public/ or tests/ changed; all tmp-*.js and %TEMP% after-file deleted; .agents/ not staged. Note for later steps: fake-DB preload recipe in FEAT-001 findings still works (mysql2/promise, express-mysql-session, web-push via Module._load; users row matched by /FROM users WHERE username/, COUNT(*) and DISTINCT user_id rows canned).
